game_title: Accumulator Pump – Mine Cart Tunnel Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Accumulator Pump: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Add values each pass until the running total reaches the goal. Each round, a new torches challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the total value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 390 points of torches by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Accumulator Pump
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how total changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 390 within 36 seconds.
